Clean Data (or load cleaned data)

Code 
# source(here("analysis", "prolific-data-cleaning.R"))
all_data_clean <- read_csv(here("data", "lineup_clean.csv")) |> 
  mutate(across(lineup_id:version, ~ as.factor(.x)),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, c("Positive", "Negative"))
         )

Look at number of replications per treatment

Code 
all_data_clean |> 
  count(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  DT::datatable()

Look at number of participants per version x treatment

Code 
all_data_clean |> 
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  DT::datatable()

Plot of all of that…

Code 
all_data_clean |>
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  filter(theta != "0") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = n, 
             fill = version)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "identity", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = "Number of Participants who evaluated the lineup",
       subtitle = str_c("By ", "<span style = 'color:#1B9E77'>**version A**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#D95F02'>**version B**</span>")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none"
        )

Look at correctness

Code 
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +

Code 
all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  group_by(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = prop_correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#1F87B4") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",

       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14)

Binomial GLMM

Source of Variation Degrees of Freedom (2520 - 1) = 2519
participant_id (210 - 1) = 209
theta (3 - 1) = 5
direction (2 - 1) = 1
cpLoc (3 - 1) = 2
sigma (2 - 1) = 1
theta x direction (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2
theta x cpLoc (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4
theta x sigma (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2
direction x cpLoc (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4
directionigma (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2
cpLoc x sigma (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2
theta x cpLoc x sigma (6 - 1)(3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 10
participant_id x theta x cpLoc x sigma - residual … = 2275 ???
Code 
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

# mod_glm <- glm(correct ~ direction*theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# aov(mod_glm) |>
#   summary()

mod <- glmer(correct ~ direction*theta_abs*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )
Code

RESULTS 1: PROBABILITY OF DETECTION

Code 
estimates <- emmeans(mod, ~ direction:theta_abs:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T))

estimates |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(cpLoc = case_when(cpLoc == "0.333333333" ~ 0.33,
                           cpLoc == "0.5" ~ 0.50,
                           cpLoc == "0.666666667" ~ 0.66)
         ) |> 
  DT::datatable()

4-way Probs – Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

Code 
emmeans(mod, ~ sigma:theta_abs:direction:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            ),
         theta_abs = fct_relevel(theta_abs, 
                                 c("5", "3", "1")
                                 ),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, 
                                 c("Negative", "Positive")
                                 )
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sigma, 
             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(y = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, 
                    ymax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(theta_abs ~ cpLoc,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Noise",
       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

RESULT 2: COMPARE ODDS POSITIVE / ODDS NEGATIVE

4-way – Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

Code 
emmeans(mod, ~ direction | theta_abs:cpLoc:sigma, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta_abs, 
             color = cpLoc,
             shape = cpLoc
             )
         ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = odds.ratio), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ .,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Odds Ratio of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \nbetween a Positive and Negative Shift",
       color = "Change Point \nLocation",
       shape = "Change Point \nLocation") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)

all_data_clean |> 
  filter(correct == 1) |> 
    mutate(cluster=stringr::str_count(choice_reason,"Clustering"),
         slope = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "slope"),

         )|> 
  filter(cpLoc == "Late",
          correct == 0) |> 
  count(choice_reason) |>
  arrange(-n)|> 
  mutate(pct=n/sum(n)*100)

Code 
all_data_clean |> 
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            )
         )|> 
  filter(cpLoc == "Late",
          correct == 0) |> 
    mutate(cluster=stringr::str_count(choice_reason,"Clustering"),
         slope = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "slope"),
         range = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "range"),
         outlier=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "Outlier"),
         shape=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "shape")
  ) |> 
  summarize(cluster=sum(cluster),
            slope=sum(slope),
            range=sum(range),
            outlier=sum(outlier),
            shape=sum(shape)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols=cluster:shape,
               names_to="response",
               values_to="count") |> 
  mutate(pct= 100*count/sum(count)) |> 
  arrange(-count)

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(DT)
library(yardstick)
library(caret)
library(tigerstats)
```

## Clean Data (or load cleaned data)

```{r}
#| output: false
# source(here("analysis", "prolific-data-cleaning.R"))
all_data_clean <- read_csv(here("data", "lineup_clean.csv")) |> 
  mutate(across(lineup_id:version, ~ as.factor(.x)),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, c("Positive", "Negative"))
         )
```

```{r}
# all_data_orig |>
#   count(participant_id) |>
#   DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```


```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(participant_id) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```

Look at number of replications per treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Look at number of participants per version x treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Plot of all of that...

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  filter(theta != "0") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = n, 
             fill = version)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "identity", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = "Number of Participants who evaluated the lineup",
       subtitle = str_c("By ", "<span style = 'color:#1B9E77'>**version A**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#D95F02'>**version B**</span>")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

Look at correctness

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Number of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#A6CEE3'>**incorrectly**</span>", "<br> identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  # complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |>
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#A6CEE3'>**incorrectly**</span>", "<br> identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  group_by(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = prop_correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#1F87B4") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14)
        )
```

## Binomial GLMM

| Source of Variation                               | Degrees of Freedom (2520 - 1) = 2519 |
|---------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| participant_id                                    | (210 - 1) = 209                      |
| theta                                             | (3 - 1) = 5                          |
| direction                                         | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| cpLoc                                             | (3 - 1) = 2                          |
| sigma                                             | (2 - 1) = 1                          |
| theta x direction                                 | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc                                     | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| theta x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| direction x cpLoc                                 | (3 - 1)(3 - 1) = 4                   |
| directionigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| cpLoc x sigma                                     | (3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 2                   |
| theta x cpLoc x sigma                             | (6 - 1)(3 - 1)(2 - 1) = 10           |
| participant_id x theta x cpLoc x sigma - residual | ... = 2275 ???                       |
|                                                   |                                      |

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

# mod_glm <- glm(correct ~ direction*theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id,
#              family = binomial(),
#              data = all_data_clean
#              )
# aov(mod_glm) |>
#   summary()

mod <- glmer(correct ~ direction*theta_abs*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )
```

```{r}
# summary(mod)
car::Anova(mod)
```

# RESULTS 1: PROBABILITY OF DETECTION

```{r}
estimates <- emmeans(mod, ~ direction:theta_abs:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T))

estimates |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(cpLoc = case_when(cpLoc == "0.333333333" ~ 0.33,
                           cpLoc == "0.5" ~ 0.50,
                           cpLoc == "0.666666667" ~ 0.66)
         ) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

### 4-way Probs -- Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ sigma:theta_abs:direction:cpLoc, type = "response", infer = c(T,T)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            ),
         theta_abs = fct_relevel(theta_abs, 
                                 c("5", "3", "1")
                                 ),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, 
                                 c("Negative", "Positive")
                                 )
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sigma, 
             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(y = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, 
                    ymax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(theta_abs ~ cpLoc,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Noise",
       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
```

### Probability of Magnitude (high baseline) for Noise Level and Direction (averaged over cpLoc)

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs:sigma:direction:cpLoc, type = "response") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(direction = fct_relevel(direction, 
                                 c("Negative","Positive")
                                 )
         ) |>

             color = direction,
             shape = direction
             )
         ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = prob), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6)
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#D95F02", "#1B9E77")) +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",

       title = "Probability of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel",
       color = "Direction",
       shape = "Direction") +

         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
```

# RESULT 2: COMPARE ODDS POSITIVE / ODDS NEGATIVE

### 4-way -- Change Point and Direction for each theta abs and sigma

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ direction | theta_abs:cpLoc:sigma, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667")
         ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = theta_abs, 
             color = cpLoc,
             shape = cpLoc
             )
         ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgray", 
             linetype = "dashed"
             ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = odds.ratio), 
             position = position_dodge(0.6),
             size=3
             ) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, 
                    xmax = asymp.UCL
                    ), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(0.6)
                ) +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ .,
             labeller = label_both
             ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.6) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(y = "",
       x = "",
       subtitle = "Mean Shift Magnitude",
       title = "Odds Ratio of Correctly Identifying the Target Panel \nbetween a Positive and Negative Shift",
       color = "Change Point \nLocation",
       shape = "Change Point \nLocation") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE),
         color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma)
```

```{r}
                                c("theta_abs5 / theta_abs3",
                                  "theta_abs3 / theta_abs1",
                                  "theta_abs5 / theta_abs1"
                                  )
                                )
        )
```

#### Table of Odds ratio estimates (Variance)

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ sigma|theta_abs, type = "response", adjust = "dunnet") |>
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) 
```

# [MF] INTERACTION CONTRASTS

### Investigating two-way interactions of change point location and direction for different combinations of magnitude and direction.

```{r}
emmeans(mod,~theta_abs:sigma:direction:cpLoc, type="response") |> 
  emmeans::joint_tests(by=c("theta_abs","sigma"))


emmeans(mod,~direction|cpLoc:theta_abs:sigma, type="response", adjust="tukey")|>
    pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as.data.frame()

emmeans(mod,~cpLoc|direction:theta_abs:sigma, type="response", adjust="tukey")|>
  pairs(infer = c(T,T), reverse = TRUE) |> 
  as.data.frame() 

  
```

```{r}
  arrange(-n)|> 
  mutate(pct=n/sum(n)*100)

all_data_clean |> 
```
```{r}
  mutate(cpLoc = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            )
         )|> 
```
```{r}
  filter(cpLoc == "Middle",
```
```{r}
          correct == 0) |> 
    mutate(cluster=stringr::str_count(choice_reason,"Clustering"),
         slope = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "slope"),
         range = stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "range"),
         outlier=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "Outlier"),
         shape=stringr::str_count(choice_reason, "shape")
  ) |> 
  summarize(cluster=sum(cluster),
            slope=sum(slope),
            range=sum(range),
            outlier=sum(outlier),
            shape=sum(shape)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols=cluster:shape,
               names_to="response",
               values_to="count") |> 
  mutate(pct= 100*count/sum(count)) |> 
  arrange(-count)

```

# Confidence in Selection

Formal statistical analysis was performed in SAS. :)

### Correct Answers
```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  mutate(conf_level=fct_relevel(conf_level, 
                                c("Strongly Agree", "Agree", "Neutral", "Disagree", "Strongly Disagree"))
  ) |> 
  filter(correct==1)->adc1
xtabs(~theta_abs+conf_level,data=adc1) |> 
  tigerstats::rowPerc()
```

### Incorrect Answers
```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  mutate(conf_level=fct_relevel(conf_level, 
                                c("Strongly Agree", "Agree", "Neutral", "Disagree", "Strongly Disagree"))
  ) |> 
  filter(correct==0)->adc2
xtabs(~theta_abs+conf_level,data=adc2) |> 
  tigerstats::rowPerc()
```

# [MF] Estimates for the odds ratios for all factors (all possible combinations)

### Magnitude
```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs | direction:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T),reverse=T) |> 
 as.data.frame()

emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs | sigma:cpLoc, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T),reverse=T) |> 
 as.data.frame()

emmeans(mod, ~ theta_abs:sigma | direction:cpLoc, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T),reverse=T) |> 
 as.data.frame()
```
### Direction
```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ direction | cpLoc:sigma:theta_abs, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as.data.frame()
```

### Variance
Averaging both directions to focus on perception of magnitude and location vs. variance. Direction vs variance was indirectly discussed in the Direction subsection.
```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ sigma | cpLoc:theta_abs, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as.data.frame()
```

### Change Point Location

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~ cpLoc | sigma:theta_abs, type = "response") |> 
  pairs(infer = c(T,T)) |> 
  as.data.frame()
```
